summary: Strong YAML workflow (pinned actions, least-privilege perms, set -euo pipefail) and well-typed TypeScript. Issues: (1) bumper.ts parseArgs() lacks input validation—invalid --dry-run values silently coerce to boolean; (2) no date format validation (line ~177)—garbage input reaches changelog untouched; (3) changelog prepending (line ~144) fragile on CHANGELOG_HEADER exact match; (4) workflow doesn't validate VERSION/commits.log exist before proceeding; (5) missing fixture file (commits.log) makes workflow non-functional as delivered. Solid separation of concerns (semver, commits, changelog, bumper) but error-handling is incomplete—scripts throw eventually but caller gets unhelpful messages. No dead code or duplication. Would benefit from composite action for Bun install to reduce repetition across workflows.
